title: Track real access, dedupe by content, and enforce evidence exclusion (VC-201-009)
goal: VC-201-009 refuted: detect() trusts caller-assembled access sets so an unrecorded held-out read reports clean; overlap is by fixture id only so identical content under another id is invisible; and 'excluded from improvement evidence' is an unconsumed flag — no caller, no gate. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_009_mastery.rs.
